name: San Gennaro Traditional Plain Polenta Roll (Pre-Cooked)
whyItWorks: Pre-cooked organic yellow cornmeal rolled into a firm cylinder. Slices smoothly into rounds that can be seared on a nonstick skillet. Zero kernels, zero hulls, 100% smooth digestible starch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice into 1/2-inch rounds and pan-sear in a skillet with olive oil for 4 minutes per side until lightly golden. Top with sensitive marinara.
